context: Tests whether the agent correctly triages PR review comments into accept/challenge/clarify categories, uses conventional commit type prefixes for accepted changes, avoids bare #<number> notation in draft replies, includes html_url links in accepted-comment replies, and plans to confirm before pushing.

checklist.name: Null check accepted

checklist.name: Null check fix: prefix
checklist.description: The accepted fix for comment 1 (null check) is associated with a `fix:` conventional commit prefix in triage-plan.md

checklist.name: Arrow function preference challenged
checklist.description: Comment 2 (arrow function style preference in routes.js) is categorized as a challenge in triage-plan.md

checklist.name: Map usage clarified

checklist.name: buildCacheKey refactor challenged

checklist.name: Typo fix docs: prefix

checklist.name: Test coverage test: prefix

checklist.name: Accepted replies link html_url

checklist.name: Push needs confirmation
